_.note: Every user-visible string in the product. A literal in a component is a string that cannot be translated, and one nobody notices is untranslatable until a second language exists.
_.keys: Named by where they are used and what they say, not by their English text: renaming the copy must not mean renaming the key.
_.review: This file is what a translator receives. Anything unclear out of context is unclear to them too.

environment.title: Development environment
environment.intro: The product is being built in the order set out in the plan. This page reports what is running right now; it does not report anything that has not been measured.
environment.asking: Asking the API whether it can serve traffic…

environment.builtSubtitle: A row appears here only once the thing behind it works end to end.

apiSkeleton.name: API skeleton
apiSkeleton.detail: FastAPI with the shared error envelope, correlation ids, security headers and a readiness probe that runs a real query.

tenantBoundary.name: Tenant boundary
tenantBoundary.detail: Sessions bind the caller's tenant to the transaction, so row-level security is in force for every statement. The credentials table is reachable only through five narrow functions.

permissionCeiling.name: Permission ceiling
permissionCeiling.detail: Company → department → resource → action, resolved by intersection so a lower scope can never widen a higher one. Refusals are audited with the layer that caused them.

designTokens.name: Design tokens
designTokens.detail: Semantic colour, spacing, radius and motion tokens in light and dark, with an explicit choice overriding the operating system.

files.name: Files
files.detail: S3-compatible storage with tenant-prefixed keys, a hash of what was actually written, and no download until a file has been scanned clean.

outboxRelay.name: Outbox relay
outboxRelay.detail: Events are written with the change that caused them and delivered at least once, with a lease, backoff and a dead-letter view. No publisher is registered yet, so nothing is delivered — and that is said rather than hidden.

tests.name: Automated tests
tests.detail: Cross-tenant isolation, sessions, the permission ceiling, idempotency, the relay and the migrations — run against a database built from the migrations themselves.
